verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a named protocol (KYAPay) that it calls 'an industry specification for identity-linked payment credentials' with JWT-based tokens and reference API docs describing token schemas (kya, pay, kya-pay) and charge/introspect endpoints, giving developers something schema-like to build against. However there is no evidence of protocol versioning, no published machine-readable schema (the OpenAPI probe returned 404s for all candidate spec files), and no conformance or validation tooling (e.g., test suites, validators, certification) is documented anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: explicit protocol version numbers, a published machine-readable schema/OpenAPI spec, and dedicated conformance/validation tooling.
